newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DOUBLE STRIKE FROM GALLACHER GIVES SCOTLAND 2-0 VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DOUBLE STRIKE FROM GALLACHER GIVES SCOTLAND 2-0 VICTORY.

text.p: Blackburn's Kevin Gallacher scored twice as Scotland beat Austria 2-0 on Wednesday to open up a commanding seven point lead in European World Cup qualifying group four.
Gallagher scored his first international goal for three and a half years to put the Scots ahead after 24 minutes at a blustery Celtic Park.
He then swept home a spectacular volley from the edge of the area late in the second half before leaving the pitch before the final whistle to a standing ovation from the 43,295-strong crowd.
Scotland have yet to concede a goal in their six World Cup matches to date. They lead the group on 14 points from Austria, who have seven points from two fewer matches.
